tasks.title: Set up project infrastructure, security foundation, and design system
tasks.description: Continue development of the initialized React Native/Expo project, configure Appwrite for backend services with university email authentication, establish security framework, and create design system
tasks.details: The basic Expo project has been initialized. Continue development by integrating Appwrite (Project ID: 6811f9090020cdcb835a, API endpoint: https://fra.cloud.appwrite.io/v1) for backend services. Implement email domain validation for university emails (@student.ubc.ca, @alumni.ubc.ca). Create authentication screens with modern UI components. Develop a comprehensive design system incorporating glassmorphism, neumorphism, and bento grid layouts for consistent UI across the app. Establish security requirements through threat modeling and risk assessment. Build authentication flows with robust security measures. Add smooth micro-interactions, ensure dark/light mode compatibility, and use gradient backgrounds with elegant typography. Configure secure session management and token storage with encryption.
tasks.testStrategy: Test email validation logic with various email formats. Verify authentication flow works end-to-end with Appwrite. Ensure proper error handling for invalid credentials and network issues. Test session persistence across app restarts. Verify UI components render correctly in both dark and light modes. Test micro-interactions and animations for smoothness across different devices. Conduct security testing for authentication mechanisms including penetration testing.

tasks.title: Develop location services integration with privacy focus

Test UI renders correctly across all supported devices.

tasks.title: Optimize performance and prepare for campus launch
tasks.description: Conduct performance optimization, testing, and final preparations for university-specific app launch
tasks.details: Conduct comprehensive security audit and penetration testing across all app features. Optimize app performance to meet requirements (cold start under 2s, card loading under 1s, etc.). Implement analytics to track user behavior and app performance with privacy considerations. Create onboarding tutorial using design system components with engaging animations explaining core features: event feed, creation, karma system, and reminders. Prepare app store assets and descriptions targeting university students. Implement crash reporting and monitoring. Fix identified security vulnerabilities. Optimize battery usage, especially for location services. Prepare marketing materials and launch strategy focusing on campus-specific rollout with university ambassadors. Conduct final user acceptance testing with target university students.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct security penetration testing across all app functions. Perform performance testing across various devices focusing on feed loading speed. Measure key metrics like app start time, card rendering, and battery impact. Test onboarding flow with new university student users. Verify analytics are correctly tracking user actions while respecting privacy. Test app on low-end devices to ensure acceptable performance. Conduct final regression testing across all features with special attention to university-specific features.
